descriptor: Fresh Common-Mode Wave Replication, Split-Panel Concordance, Contemporaneous Cross-Provider Pairing, Schedule-Randomized Temporal Localization & External-Confound Adjudication

predecessor.key_result: After exact technical completion and corrected Holm adjudication, Gemini valid and null both showed wave_synchrony with Holm-adjusted p=0.0023995200959808036; GPT-OSS showed no corrected primary signal.

scientific_question: Does the P46 Gemini-arm wave-synchrony signal independently replicate under fresh waves and contemporaneous cross-provider interleaving, and if it does, is it coherent across pre-frozen disjoint cell panels and shared across model/provider arms, or does it remain an arm-specific common-mode temporal modulation?

frozen_surface.aliases: Exact A/B/C/D archive constructions from P44-P46.
frozen_surface.response_contract: Exact P42-P46 provider-native strict contracts; no reselection.
frozen_surface.cell_order: Within each wave, all 256 semantic×vertex×alias cells are independently randomized by a frozen deterministic PRNG seed.
frozen_surface.paired_execution: For every cell in a wave, the two model arms are executed consecutively; which arm is first alternates by frozen wave-position parity.
frozen_surface.panel_partition: Within each semantic twin, panel P0 iff (vertex_index + alias_index) mod 2 = 0, otherwise P1. The partition is fixed before P47 outcomes.

primary_replication_family.tests: Four wave-synchrony tests: 2 model arms × 2 semantic twins.
primary_replication_family.statistic: Variance across waves of cell-centered residual failure means, identical in meaning to P46.
primary_replication_family.null: 5000 within-cell wave-label permutations preserving each cell's total failures.
primary_replication_family.multiplicity: Holm FWER=0.05 across the four replication tests.
primary_replication_family.model_level_replication_gate: Both semantic twins for a model must reject after Holm correction.

conditional_localization_family.interpretation_gate: Localization results acquire confirmatory authority only if Gemini passes the model-level replication gate.
conditional_localization_family.split_panel_tests: For each model×semantic, Pearson correlation between the 8-wave residual-mean vectors from P0 and P1; exact 8! wave-label permutation of P1.
conditional_localization_family.cross_arm_tests: For each semantic, Pearson correlation between contemporaneous 8-wave residual-mean vectors for GPT-OSS and Gemini; exact 8! permutation of one arm.
conditional_localization_family.multiplicity: Holm FWER=0.05 across the six localization tests.
conditional_localization_family.model_panel_coherence: Both semantic twins' split-panel tests must reject after Holm correction.
conditional_localization_family.cross_arm_common_time: Both semantic twins' cross-arm tests must reject after Holm correction.

secondary_diagnostics: Per-wave residual means by model and semantic.
Within-wave normalized position association with cell-centered outcomes.
API-call latency by model, wave and position.

gates.technical: Every model×semantic×vertex×alias cell requires >=7/8 exact-schema successful calls.
gates.evaluation_artifact: Primary-vs-shadow disagreement >=10% for a technically evaluable model triggers EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_DOMINANT.
gates.replication: Gemini must reject wave_synchrony in both semantic twins after the four-test Holm family.
gates.arm_specific_common_mode: Gemini replication passes; Gemini split-panel coherence passes in both semantics; cross-arm common-time gate does not pass.
gates.cross_arm_common_time: Gemini replication passes and both semantic cross-arm correlations survive localization-family Holm correction.

frozen_rules: P47 does not select cells based on P46 significance; all fixed cells are replayed.
The P46 Holm implementation bug is repaired before P47 and P47 includes a zero-call unit test that verifies p-value sorting.
Contemporaneous pairing reduces, but does not eliminate, provider/runtime confounding.
A synchronized wave effect is an observed common-mode behavioral modulation, not an identified internal neural state.
Model identity and provider/runtime remain confounded within each arm.
No threshold, panel, statistic or multiplicity change after P47 outcomes.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P47 alone.

missing_high_value_acquisition.citation: Atil et al. (2025), Non-Determinism of Deterministic LLM System Settings in Hosted Environments
missing_high_value_acquisition.reason: Direct hosted-API nondeterminism comparator; useful novelty-kill and external-confound donor.
